app.name: SmartFarm Sierra Leone
app.tagline: Farming advice, weather, suppliers and buyers in one place.

home.title: Grow more, sell better
home.intro: SmartFarm helps farmers in all 16 districts of Sierra Leone get advice, weather, inputs and buyers.
home.businessHint: Suppliers, buyers and lenders: sign in with your phone, then register your organisation.

login.title: Sign in with your phone
login.intro: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS. No email or password needed.
login.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Sierra Leone phone number, for example 076 123 456.
login.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Please wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
login.invalidCode: That code is not correct. You have {count} tries left.
login.invalidCodeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
login.expiredCode: This code has expired or was replaced. Request a new code.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong tries. Request a new code.
login.verifyRateLimited: Too many tries from this connection. Please wait and try again later.
login.codeResent: We sent you a new code.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your farm
onboarding.intro: This helps us show advice and weather for your area. You can change it later.
onboarding.chiefdomHint: Pick a chiefdom in the district you chose.
onboarding.errorChiefdom: That chiefdom is not in the district you chose.
onboarding.errorFarmSize: Enter a farm size greater than 0, or leave it empty.

farmer.comingSoonIntro: These services are being added to SmartFarm:
farmer.findSuppliersHint: Verified sellers of seeds, fertiliser and tools near you.

business.title: Business portal
business.intro: Register your organisation, upload documents and get verified.
business.draftHelp: Upload the documents below, then submit for verification.
business.pendingHelp: Thank you. SmartFarm is checking your documents. We will send you an SMS when it is done.
business.approvedHelp: Your organisation is verified. Buy requests and loan products open in a later release.
business.rejectedHelp: Your organisation was not approved for this reason:
business.rejectedFix: Fix the problem, update your details or documents, and submit again.
business.documentsHelp: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each. Only SmartFarm staff can see them.
business.docLicenceHelp: Required for lenders and for suppliers of agrochemicals.
business.errorTooLarge: This file is larger than 5 MB.
business.errorWrongType: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files are accepted.
business.errorNotEditable: You can't change this while it is under review.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.intro: Verify businesses, moderate listings and review advice.
admin.documentLinkHelp: Links work for 5 minutes. Reload the page for new links.
admin.rejectReason: Reason for rejection (sent to the business)
admin.rejectReasonHint: At least 10 characters. Say what to fix.
admin.errorReason: Write a reason of at least 10 characters.
admin.errorNotPending: This organisation is no longer waiting for review.
admin.listingsIntro: Hide listings that break the rules, and mark paid placements as Sponsored.

forbidden.title: You can't open this page
forbidden.body: Your account does not have access to this part of SmartFarm.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back later.
errors.notFoundBody: We could not find that page.

registerBusiness.title: Register your organisation
registerBusiness.intro: Tell us about your business. SmartFarm verifies every organisation before it can publish listings.
registerBusiness.phoneHint: Sierra Leone number. Farmers will call this number.
registerBusiness.agrochemicalsHint: Agrochemical dealers must upload their dealer licence.
registerBusiness.errorPhone: Enter a valid Sierra Leone phone number.
registerBusiness.errorEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
registerBusiness.errorFarmerAccount: This phone number is registered as a farmer. Use a different number for your business.
registerBusiness.errorNotEditable: Your organisation is under review, so details can't be changed now.

suppliers.title: Find suppliers
suppliers.intro: Seeds, fertiliser, tools and machinery from suppliers verified by SmartFarm.
suppliers.noResults: No suppliers found. Try another district or category.

listings.title: Product listings
listings.intro: Farmers see active listings in the supplier directory.
listings.hiddenHelp: SmartFarm has hidden this listing. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
listings.notApproved: You can add listings once SmartFarm has verified your organisation.
listings.notSupplier: Product listings are for suppliers. Buy requests and loan products come in a later release.
listings.descriptionHint: What it is, quantity, quality, delivery.
listings.priceHint: Leave empty to show "Ask for price".
listings.districtsHint: Choose every district you sell or deliver to.
listings.photosHint: Up to 3 photos, JPG or PNG, 2 MB each.
listings.photosReplaceHint: Choosing new photos replaces the current ones.
listings.errorTitle: Enter a product name (3 to 100 characters).
listings.errorPrice: Enter a price like 250 or 1250.50, or leave it empty.
listings.errorContactPhone: Enter a valid Sierra Leone phone number.
listings.errorWhatsapp: Enter a valid Sierra Leone number, or leave it empty.
listings.errorPhotos: Up to 3 photos, JPG or PNG only, 2 MB each.
listings.errorAgrochemicals: Only suppliers verified with an agrochemical dealer licence can list agrochemicals.

weather.title: Weather
weather.stale: We could not get a new forecast. This one is from {time}.
weather.unavailable: The forecast is not available right now. Please try again later.
weather.noTips: No special weather warnings this week.
weather.tip_heavyRain: Heavy rain expected {day} ({mm} mm). Delay fertiliser and spraying so they don't wash away.
weather.tip_dryspell: Dry spell from {day} for about {days} days. Mulch, and water seedlings early or late in the day.
weather.tip_heat: Very hot {day} ({temp}°C). Work and water early in the morning or late in the afternoon.

guides.title: Crop guides
guides.intro: Practical advice for planting, pests, diseases and harvest, checked by agronomists.
guides.noneYet: This guide is not ready yet. Ask your extension officer in the meantime.
guides.sampleBanner: Sample text for testing. Not yet reviewed by an agronomist. Do not rely on it.
guides.savedOffline: You can open this guide again without internet on this phone.

adminGuides.title: Crop guide editor
adminGuides.intro: Edit guide sections. Saving clears the review: a reviewer must publish the section again before farmers see it.
adminGuides.contentHint: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Start a line with "- " for a bullet point.
adminGuides.saved: Saved. Review and publish when it is ready.

offline.banner: You are offline. Showing what is saved on this phone.
offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page is not saved on your phone yet. Crop guides and the weather you opened before still work offline.
